Stability = CER between the model's transcript of your original audio and of the degraded copy; no reference needed. Validated on FLEURS: for Prisma, mean stability tracks the true WER increase (Spearman ρ = 0.59 per folder, points near y = x). It is not calibrated for Whisper. Entity retention = share of amounts/dates in the original transcript that survive.
